card.name: "Of" after care or management
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "management" or "care" when a condition or patient group follows, as in "management of pain". Also "found" in "are found to require".

modes.label: of after management/care
modes.description: The word "of" following "management" or "care", just before the condition or patients being treated.
modes.example: The potential for these risks should not, however, prevent the proper management<< of>> pain in any given patient.

modes.label: found to require
modes.description: The word "found" in a patient already on a drug who is found to need another therapy.
modes.example: Patients stabilized on oral anticoagulants who are<< found>> to require thyroid replacement therapy should be watched

card.plain: It fires on the small word "of" in phrases like "management of" or "care of" that lead into a condition or patient group.
